''See also: [[Brother Aekin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Brother Aekin, also known as Aekin, was an [[Uncrowned]] member of the [[Abyssal Palace]], a cult dedicated to the [[Wandering Titan]]. He was characterized by his slate gray or black and brown [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]] and a dark [[stone]] [[The mask|mask]] carved to look like a snarling creature, which featured a glowing yellow eye. In combat, Aekin utilized a hammer and various magical abilities, including the use of [[yellow madra]] to perform [[Enforcer techniques]] that acted as translucent armor. He was capable of combining [[Striker]] and [[Ruler techniques]], such as conjuring projectiles made of [[stone]] fragments and golden light. Although his [[Path]] focused on endurance—allowing him to survive severe injuries like broken limbs and a damaged neck—he was eventually defeated. During a confrontation in the [[Hollow Domain]], his techniques failed, leading to his death within seconds.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|This [[Uncrowned]] of [[Abyssal Palace]] wears hooded [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]]. He also dons a [[stone]] [[The mask|mask]] featuring a single glowing yellow eye.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Maraan]] oversaw the early training of Brother Aekin. He is a rematch opponent for [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], who also targeted him during a brief rampage. Additionally, Aekin competed against [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] in a [[tournament]] where she obliterated him, and he was once considered an opponent [[Lindon]] believed he could defeat.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|His [[Path]] is modeled after the [[Wandering Titan]] and focuses on endurance. He utilizes an [[Enforcer technique]] to take on the aspect of the [[Wandering Titan]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|An [[Uncrowned]] of [[Abyssal Palace]], Brother Aekin arrived wearing hooded [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist’s robes]] and having undergone early training under [[Maraan]]. His [[Path]], which emphasizes endurance, was modeled after the [[Wandering Titan]] and featured an [[Enforcer technique]] used to take on that aspect. During a [[tournament]], he faced [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], who targeted him during a brief rampage, and was also scheduled to fight [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]. Ultimately, Aekin competed against [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] and was obliterated by her. He was also a member of the group under the [[Sage of Red Faith]] that ambushed [[Mercy]] and [[Akura Pride|Pride]].}}
